title: Export file
description: A board, or one of its containers, as it stands now: its containers, cards and links as the `write_board` items that draw them, each with a `key`, and the person's answers, places and, when asked, notes, naming their card by that key. No history, no card numbers. `write_board`'s `import` takes it back.
$comment: Was: D-107; api.md 197-199. The wrapper is the only new shape: `items` are write items (write-item.schema.json), of three types.

notes.text: Per seat suits a growing team.

v.description: The export format's version. A file of an older version is upgraded before it is read.

title.description: The board's title, or the container's: an import into a new board takes it as the board's.

items.$comment: Bounded as every list is; write_board's 512 KiB body binds first.

type.description: An export draws with these three item types only.

items.description: The `region`, `node` and `link` items that draw it, in an order that writes: each container before its cards, each card before its links. A link names its cards by `{ key }`.

answers.description: The person's ✓ and ✗ on the cards that ask. Only the person's import applies them, as the person's own acts.

pins.description: Where the person placed a card in its container; the containers themselves are placed by the layout.

key.description: The card's or the container's key in `items`.

keys.description: A note on a group of cards, in place of `key`: each card's key.

thread.description: The agent's replies to this note, oldest first.

notes.description: The person's notes and the agent's replies to them, when the export was asked for them; left out otherwise.
